question: Should outbound recovery keep ambiguous rows pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, after the no-op pacing blocker is fixed?
rationale: Tests can prove the queue behavior, but the product tradeoff between future recoverability and a clear terminal failed state affects operator expectations and message-delivery recovery semantics.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Repair
options.body: Merge after the pacing fix and green exact-head validation if maintainers want no-adapter ambiguous rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer current main's terminal failed behavior until the full delivery ledger design is ready.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API surface before changing ambiguous rows to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge after the pacing fix and green exact-head validation if maintainers want no-adapter ambiguous rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses core queue semantics and operator-visible delivery recovery, and this owner appears in recent delivery recovery coordination history.
